translation.name: Godɨn Eghaghanim: Akar Gavgavir Dɨkɨrɨzir Ghurim ko Igiam

book.name: Onger Akaba
book.title: Godɨn Ziam Fer Onger Akabar Akɨnafarim O Onger Akaba

content: Me dagher igiaba inigha, da bagha God mɨnabi
Gumazir onger akabar faragha zuim, kar an onger akam. Gumazir kam, gumazir gitabav sozibav kemezɨ me ighiam gami.

content.text: God, e kamaghɨn nɨn azai, nɨ deraghvɨra e damuva en apangkuv.
Mati nɨn angazangarim e gisirazɨ moghɨn,
nɨ ragh en gan en akurvagh.

content: (Ighiam gamua an suiamatugha avughsegha uaighiam gami.)

content.text: Eghtɨ nguazimɨn gumazamiziba ganigh nɨn arazibagh fogham.
Me kamaghɨn fogham, nɨ gavgavir bar ekiam ikia men akurvasi.
O God, nan ifongiam, gumazamiziba bar nɨ gifuegh nɨn ziam fɨ.
Guizbangɨra, me nɨn ziar ekiam pɨrafam.
Nɨ guizbangɨra gumazamizibar araziba tuisɨgha, tuavir aghuim men akazɨ, me nɨn ifongiamɨn gɨrara zui.
Kamaghɨn amizɨ, gumazamizibar naviba bar akueghɨva,

content: (Ighiam gamua an suiamatugha avughsegha uaighiam gami.)

content.text: O God, nan ifongiam, gumazamiziba bar nɨ gifuegh nɨn ziam fɨ.
Guizbangɨra, me nɨn ziar ekiam pɨrafam.
Ezɨ dagher aghuir avɨriba en nguazibar otifi.
Bar guizbangɨra, God deragha e gami.
Nguazimɨn gumazamiziba bar an atiating an apengan ikɨ.
